newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Rioters burn police station in Albanian town.
newsitem.headline: Rioters burn police station in Albanian town.

text.p: Rioters stormed a police station and set it on fire on Sunday in the southern Albanian town of Gjirokaster, witnesses said.

The attack took place shortly after parliament in the capital Tirana declared an immediate state of emergency in the face of spreading rebellion in the south of the country against President Sali Berisha and his ruling Democratic Party.
"I can see flames and smoke rising from the police station," one witness said.
Ambulance sirens and the crackle of automatic gunfire could be heard in Gjirokaster, the main town in southern Albania, but it was not clear whether there had been casualties.

Witnesses said 20 to 30 masked demonstrators had sprayed the police building with fire from Kalashnikov assault rifles, forcing police inside to abandon the premises, before entering and setting it to the torch.
A police officer in Gjirokaster said he believed the demonstrators had seized their weapons in a raid on a police arms depot in the village of Pitsari, about 20 km (12 miles) north of Gjirokaster.
